html_evidence.observation: Single empty group container; populated dynamically at runtime by drawSettledDoxai() function. Visual realisation: one rounded-corner box (line 826: SETTLED_X=40, SETTLED_Y=1115, SETTLED_W=180, SETTLED_H=60) with a single connector arc to M23. No sub-structure, no taxonomy of hexeis, no link to the broader hexis–pathē correlate analysis in §1.4.

Three expanded-content blocks total (practical syllogism; additional unmoved originator; habitual rational action) — substantively thinner than the DOXA band (six blocks) or any A3 sub-node (≥5 blocks each). The 'craft-procedural vs. evaluatively-complex' bivalence introduced in §1.5 line 1 has no diagrammatic representation.

The feedback path from EMO (line 1452) returns to A2 (line 376–379 of the reference TikZ; HTML feedback-path js); there is NO feedback path linking emotional/habitual outcomes back into the SETTLED_DOXAI hexis-reservoir as the §1.4 diachronic-saturation analysis (lines 106, 110, 112, 174) requires.
